'''Flint County''' is a county appearing in {{SA}}, located in the state of [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]]. It makes up the southwestern portion of the map, and is connected to the remaining land masses by numerous bridges. To the east of Flint County is [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]] and [[Red County (3D Universe)|Red County]], to the north is [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]], and to the west is [[Whetstone]]. Flint County is the least populated area in San Andreas, and has no towns, yet is one of the largest counties in the state.

==Description==
Flint County is characterized by its rugged terrain. [[Back o Beyond]], which includes the entire southern half of the county, is hilly and virtually uninhabited except for a couple gas stations and trailer parks. There are a few farms in the northern and western parts, and most of the northern part is mountainous and difficult to cross off-road.

A [[Whetstone-Flint County Creek|creek]] separates Flint County and Whetstone, while [[Flint Water]], the [[Los Santos Inlet]], and an unnamed river form the border with Los Santos and Red County.

==Events in ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''==
{{Spoiler}}
After [[Carl Johnson]] has spent a while in the countryside, [[Frank Tenpenny]] shows up again in [[Angel Pine]], in the [[U Get Inn Motel]], this time to introduce Carl Johnson to [[The Truth]], a weed-growing hippie that provides illicit narcotics to the corrupt [[C.R.A.S.H.]] officers. Carl, ordered by Tenpenny to pay The Truth the cash that is owed to him for a recent transaction, is indentured into service to The Truth in order to pay off the "debt". His first task is to [[Body Harvest|steal]] a [[Combine Harvester|combine harvester]] from a [[Survivalists|group of right-wing fanatics]] occupying [[The Farm]] in northern Flint County, and return it to The Truth. Eventually, Carl must assist The Truth in [[Are You Going to San Fierro?|destroying a large crop of marijuana]] that has been discovered by the authorities. Immediately after destroying the crops and [[Rocket Launcher (3D Universe)|shooting down]] the [[Police Maverick (3D Universe)|patrolling helicopter]], the two men drive to [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]] in The Truth's hippie bus nicknamed the [[Camper (3D Universe)#Variants|Mothership]], with three tons of marijuana in tow, opening the next chapter in the storyline.

==Influence==
The southern coast of Flint County is based on the {{WP|Central Coast (California)|California Central Coast}} including the {{WP|Gaviota Tunnel}}. The rugged interior of Back o Beyond is similar to {{WP|Yosemite National Park|Yosemite}} and {{WP|Kings Canyon National Park|Kings Canyon}} National Parks, while the landscape north of Back o Beyond appears more influenced by the rural {{WP|Santa Cruz Mountains}} south of San Francisco.
